classification.rationale: A 'ship propulsion unit' could be a marine engine (8407/8408), an electric thruster (8501), a waterjet (8412) or a drive part (8483/8487); the 6-digit subheading depends on the engine type and construction, so I ask. H82350 (in force) classified an inboard engine with outboard drive across 8407.29, 8412.29 and 8483.40 and shows that components split by type.
